items.headline: Eagles QB Jalen Hurts on IR due to blood clot, expected to be out indefinitely
items.description: The Eagles have placed Jalen Hurts on injured reserve after consultations with numerous doctors and experts, sources told ESPN and NFL Network.

items.headline: Sources: Eagles' Jalen Hurts, out indefinitely with blood clot, not planned for IR
items.description: The Eagles are not planning to put Jalen Hurts on injured reserve, sources told ESPN, even as he remains sidelined indefinitely with a superficial blood clot.

items.headline: Eagles' Saquon Barkley ruled out; DeVonta Smith likely to return
items.description: Eagles RB Saquon Barkley has been ruled out for Sunday's game against the Panthers with a hamstring injury, but it appears WR DeVonta Smith will return.

items.headline: Jalen Hurts' health bigger than football, as teammates, coach detail QB concern
items.description: Eagles coach Nick Sirianni declined to offer much detail about Jalen Hurts' health, instead focusing on his connection with the quarterback.
